description: Run TAO Data Services TMM unique-neighbor matching mining from embedding parquet files for object detection workflows. Use when an object detection workflow needs to mine a bijectively-assigned set of unique source images closest to target samples. Use global allocation when mining without class constraints. Use class_stratified when rare classes are specified.
